overview: A surfer becomes the head of a major company.

recs.blurb: An inventor and his mom hit the road together so he can sell his latest invention.
Three friends who head the Social Committee in a frat house, called KOK (Kappa Omicron Kappa), are charged with stealing money their fraternity has been saving…
A small business owner is about to lose her shop to a major corporate development.
Steve Martin and Bonnie Hunt return as heads of the Baker family who, while on vacation, find themselves in competition with a rival family of eight children…
A wave twisting tale of a soul searching surfer experiencing an existential crisis.
Derek and Hansel are modelling again when an opposing company attempts to take them out from the business.
A naive business graduate is installed as president of a manufacturing company as part of a stock scam.
Mafia hitman Tommy Spinelli (Joe Pesci) is flying to San Diego with a bag that holds eight severed heads, which he's bringing to his superiors to prove that…
A man becomes increasingly jealous of his friend's newfound success.
Valentin is Acapulco's resident playboy, until a former fling leaves a baby on his doorstep and him heading with her out of Mexico.
Two surfers end up as Yellowstone park rangers and have to stop a former ranger who is out for revenge.
